metadata.title: Ronaq Store — Pakistan's Mobile & Electronics Store Directory
metadata.description: Find local mobile and electronics shops in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad and all cities of Pakistan. View stock, phones, chargers, and accessories.

faq.a1: Ronaq Store lets you browse phones and accessories from local shops across Pakistan, filter by city, and contact shops on WhatsApp — no buyer account needed.
faq.a2: Yes. Only shops that pass review and keep their store online appear in the public directory.
faq.q3: How do I buy a product?
faq.a3: Open a product or shop page, then use Order via WhatsApp to message the shop directly about price and availability.
